yellow.note: Always laid with the grain tile; nets to about rgb(247 221 29) on screen.

yellow-print.note: Canvas and raster yellow (halftone discs and halos, swash, share card, favicon, field focus ring). Must read as the same yellow as Highlighter Yellow.

ink.note: The halftone printer uses #141414 for its dots.

paper.note: Nets to about rgb(240 237 231) on screen under the grain overlay; outside CSS use #F0EDE7 (theme-color) or #EEEBE5 (share card).

fiber.note: The halftone printer fills cut-out bodies with #F4F2EC.

display.purpose: The word "Blame" on the home tape only, fitted in JS to the tape width (max 172px, 162px on the desk).

headline.purpose: Screen headlines on yellow tape; the verdict headline is fitted between 30px and 104px, one tape per line.

deck.purpose: The home question under the title; the deadline number steps it down to 44px.

banner.purpose: EXCLUSIVE in white uppercase on red tape; 33px on inner screens.

nameplate.purpose: The centred "Blame" in the inner-screen masthead.

button-display.purpose: Label of the yellow primary button.

strip.purpose: White type on black caption strips; the jab is fitted to one line from 26px down to 19px.

name.purpose: A person's name in a split row.

figure.purpose: Bold tabular percentage at the right of each row.

button-condensed.purpose: Label of the black share button.

label.purpose: Badge names, the measure toggle (19px), disclosure summaries.

input.purpose: Text typed into the repo, token and date fields.

body.purpose: Default page text; secondary text runs 16-17px in Soft Ink or Faded Caption.

caption.purpose: Notes, row meta and small-print lists; the footer is 15px.

shadows.name: button-yellow
shadows.purpose: Warm, tight lift under the yellow primary button.

shadows.name: button-black
shadows.purpose: Lift under the black share button.

shadows.name: paper-on-desk
shadows.purpose: The paper column on the grey desk at 560px and wider.

shadows.name: sheet
shadows.purpose: The share dialog, over a rgb(18 18 18 / .55) backdrop.

shadows.name: bar-fill-inset
shadows.purpose: Faint ink pooling along the bottom of a yellow bar fill.

shadows.name: field-focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Print Yellow ring around a focused field (border turns Press Black).

shadows.name: foot-lip
shadows.purpose: White paper lip along the torn top of the black foot.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The house ease (CSS --ease-out): bar fills, portrait print, jab rise, button press, progress bar.

motion.name: ease-slam
motion.purpose: Overshoot for tapes slamming onto the page (split / verdict).

motion.name: bar-fill
motion.value: transform scaleX(0 -> 1), 1100ms, delay 160ms + 110ms per row, ease-out
motion.purpose: Split rows print in rank order; on a measure switch bars grow from their previous width with no delay.

motion.name: count-up
motion.value: 1100ms, quartic ease-out 1 - (1 - k)^4, same clock as the bar
motion.purpose: Row percentages count up from 0 while the bar fills.

motion.name: tape-slam-split
motion.value: rotate(-6deg) scale(1.18), opacity 0 -> rotate(-1.6deg) scale(1), 420ms, ease-slam

motion.name: tape-slam-verdict
motion.value: rotate(-9deg) scale(1.3), opacity 0 -> rotate(-2.4deg) scale(1), 460ms, 140ms stagger per line
motion.purpose: Each verdict headline tape lands in turn.

motion.name: portrait-print
motion.purpose: The verdict portrait prints top to bottom.

motion.name: jab-rise
motion.value: translateY(16px), opacity 0 -> rest at rotate(-1.4deg), 500ms, delay 700ms, ease-out
motion.purpose: The jab strip rises after the portrait prints.

motion.name: busy-nudge
motion.purpose: The arrow nudges while a button is busy.

motion.name: progress
motion.purpose: Fetch progress bar under the form.

motion.name: screen-change
motion.purpose: Switching between home, split and verdict.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Every entrance, slam, print wipe, count-up and view transition is skipped; CSS durations drop to .01ms and JS returns before animating.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Gutter 12px, 60px avatars, name 24px, figure 26px, measure label hidden.

breakpoints.name: paper
breakpoints.purpose: Max width of the single paper column.

breakpoints.name: desk
breakpoints.purpose: Body becomes the grey desk; the paper floats with a 28px margin and the paper-on-desk shadow; title 162px, deck 46px.

narrative.overview:
Blame prints a repo's git history as the front page of a cheap tabloid, and the group-project fight is the scandal. Every screen is one sheet of warm newsprint (the paper token under an SVG grain tile and a large crumple-lighting texture) in a single phone-width column, and everything on that sheet is something a sub-editor would paste down by hand: torn yellow highlighter tape behind black Anton headlines, one red EXCLUSIVE banner, black caption strips reversed out in white condensed type, faces printed as black halftone dots on yellow, hand-inked crowns and burst marks, and torn black paper at the foot. Nothing is a card, a panel or a chart.

The page has two volumes. The top of each screen is front-page loud: banner, headline tape, a halftone portrait or lineup that bleeds to the paper edge, a black strip with the jab. Underneath it goes quiet: rows of names and percentages separated by thin column rules, then the small print under a double rule in muted condensed type. The loud layer is always Anton on yellow; the quiet layer is always Barlow Condensed on bare paper. The share card (1080x1920, drawn on canvas) is the same front page re-set for a group chat, built from the same tape, banner, strip, halftone and torn foot.

The world's motion only narrates printing: tapes slam onto the page, the portrait prints top to bottom, bars fill and their numbers count up, the jab rises into place. The confirmed rejection is the category default, a GitHub-insights dashboard of cards, axes and line charts; the owner picked this tabloid board over courtroom, git-graph, report-card and receipt concepts.
keyCharacteristics: One 460px paper column; on wide screens it lies on a grey desk with a soft paper shadow.
Two faces only: Anton for anything a tabloid would print as a headline, Barlow Condensed for everything you read.
Yellow is the single highlight and the single data colour; red appears once per screen.
Printed matter is torn (seeded clip-path polygons); touch controls are softly rounded.
Paper pieces tilt counter-clockwise between 1 and 4 degrees; controls stay level.
Every face is printed at runtime as 45-degree halftone dots, never shown as a raw photo.
Depth comes from stacked paper (fiber underlays, torn edges, tilt), not shadows.

rules.name: The Highlighter Rule
rules.body: Yellow is the only colour that highlights and the only colour that measures. Headlines sit on it, bars fill with it, faces are printed on it, badges are cut from it. No second accent and no new yellows; Deep Yellow is a focus outline, never a fill.

rules.name: The One Banner Rule
rules.body: Red is the EXCLUSIVE tape, once per screen, top left, pasted over the headline tape. Its only other job is the 1.5px border of an invalid field. It never fills a button or colours a number, a link or text; error text uses a darker #A3150F so it stays readable and the banner red keeps its meaning.

rules.name: The Netted Paper Rule
rules.body: Grain darkens the paper by about eight levels, so anything drawn outside CSS that must sit flush with the page uses the on-screen value, not the token: the browser theme colour is #F0EDE7 and the share card's ground is #EEEBE5.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Anton for what the front page shouts (title, headlines, deck, banner, nameplate, the deadline number, the yellow button); Barlow Condensed for everything read (names, figures, strips, body, notes, fields, the share button). No third face.

rules.name: The Fill-the-Tape Rule
rules.body: Headline type is sized to its tape, not to a fixed scale: the title and the verdict headline are measured with canvas text metrics and set as large as the column allows, and a headline never wraps inside a tape. A second line gets its own tape; only the deck wraps.

rules.name: The Tabular Figure Rule
rules.body: Percentages are bold tabular figures, right-aligned against the name, so a count-up never jitters and the column of numbers reads as a ranking.

rules.name: The Paper-Stack Rule
rules.body: Lift a printed piece with a fiber underlay, a torn edge, an overlap or a tilt, never with a drop shadow. Shadows are reserved for the buttons, the page on the desk and the dialog.

rules.name: The Torn-or-Rounded Rule
rules.body: If it is printed, tear it; if it is a field or a full-width button, round it (8 to 10px). Never round a tape and never tear a field.

rules.name: The Counter-Clockwise Rule
rules.body: Paper pieces tilt between -1 and -4 degrees (title -1.4, headline -1.6, verdict tapes -2.4 and -1.2, deck -3.6, banner -4, strips -1.4, deadline box -1). Only adjacent siblings may break the pattern, by at most +1 degree, to look hand-pasted. Fields, buttons and rows stay level. Ink doodles and the painted swash (-14 degrees) are freehand and exempt.

rules.name: The Constant-Bite Rule
rules.body: Edit torn edges by changing tools/make-torn.mjs and regenerating torn.css, never by hand, and reuse one of the eight edges rather than adding a ninth for a single element.

dos: **Do** set every headline in Anton on a torn Highlighter Yellow tape with the fiber underlay, tilted between -1 and -4 degrees, and fit its size to the column.
**Do** lay the grain tile over every printed fill (tapes, strips, banner, bars, buttons, foot) so colour reads as ink on paper.
**Do** print every face through js/halftone.js at the cell pitches above; show the plain image only as the fallback before the canvas prints.
**Do** keep each screen's primary action a full-width Highlighter Yellow Anton button at least 60px tall; the only black button is the share action.
**Do** keep the quiet layer quiet: notes, meta and small print in Barlow Condensed 16 to 17px in Faded Caption or Soft Ink, under 1px Column Rule hairlines or a 3px double Press Black rule.
**Do** keep fonts and images self-hosted; the page's Content-Security-Policy allows fonts, styles and scripts from its own origin only.
**Do** ship every generated raster with a .json provenance sidecar beside it (prompt, model, post-processing), as assets/suspects/*.webp and assets/swash.webp do.
**Do** mirror colour changes in js/halftone.js and js/card.js, which carry literal copies of the tokens (print ink #141414, Print Yellow, cut-out fill #F4F2EC, card ground #EEEBE5).
**Do** skip every entrance, slam, print wipe, count-up and view transition under prefers-reduced-motion, leaving the final layout static.
donts: **Don't** use Exclusive Red beyond the EXCLUSIVE banner and the invalid-field border, and don't add a second banner, kicker or small label above a headline.
**Don't** add charts, axes, legends or dashboard cards; the only data marks are the yellow bar, the big Anton number and the tabular percentage.
**Don't** set headlines in Barlow Condensed or reading text in Anton, and don't bring in a third face.
**Don't** lift printed pieces with drop shadows; overlap, tear and tilt them instead.
**Don't** round a tape, strip or badge, and don't tear a field or a full-width button.
**Don't** tilt fields, buttons or rows, and don't tilt paper pieces clockwise beyond +1 degree.
**Don't** hand-edit torn.css or add a one-off torn edge; regenerate from tools/make-torn.mjs.
**Don't** show a face as a raw colour photo.
